parallels.note: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

translations.web: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
translations.bsb: He was told, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.”
translations.kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
translations.asv: And it was told him, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
